title: Solar Power Prediction System
subtitle: AI-Powered Solar Energy Forecasting
imageCaptions: Weather page (simulated data): five sources lined up every 15 minutes, then cleaned
Airflow page: the 15-minute forecast DAG, from fetching data to writing MySQL
Model page: a year of daily accuracy, with the rainy months standing out in red
description: Time-series models that forecast solar output for an energy-storage demonstration site, scheduled with Airflow. The sun is punctual; the clouds are the problem. The dashboards here are redrawn on simulated data.
longDescription: Built a comprehensive solar power prediction system for Tainan FamilyMart Pingfeng store energy storage demonstration site. The system combines weather data, historical generation patterns, and machine learning models to provide accurate solar power forecasts.
solutions: Built robust data pipeline with Airflow
results: Enhanced AI showcase for the facility
why: Built at HD Renewables for an energy-storage demonstration site, which needs to know how much solar power is on the way. The forecast combines weather data, past generation and time-series models.
gains: Gives an energy-storage site a forecast of the solar power on its way, so the storage plan is made with a forecast instead of a hunch. The project records 92% accuracy on daily forecasts and 25% lower storage costs.
